description.value: Kelly & Carlos O'Bryan's is a multi-concept venue in the heart of downtown Kelowna, combining a full-service neighborhood restaurant, a pub, and a rooftop patio ('Rooftop Paddy O') just a short walk from Okanagan Lake. Part of a BC-wide chain with Irish-pub-inspired character, the Kelowna location hosts regular live events, karaoke, and DJ nights, and features a broad menu including local Okanagan wines. It sits in a walkable downtown core that is convenient as a resupply or meal stop mid-ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 97m; lockers (secure) at 99m.
